text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unchanged by her debut, Agnes Tachyon continues to put her research first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I develop a three-year race schedule which would see her through the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She reviews the schedule, but insists that, in order to prioritize her research, she'll decide for herself which races to enter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, my efforts succeed in turning her attention toward the Classics and its preliminary race, the Yayoi Sho.
